info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Proustit Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Proustit Recliner Details Management API facilitates the creation and management of detailed information regarding the Proustit Recliner within the product catalog. This endpoint allows businesses to add new recliner details, ensuring that the catalog remains up-to-date and informative. It is particularly beneficial for inventory managers and e-commerce platforms that require accurate product specifications to enhance customer experience. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the process of updating product details and ensure consistency across applications.

post.summary: Create new details for a Proustit recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit detailed information about a Proustit recliner. It accepts relevant data as input and stores the information for future reference, enabling effective management of recliner details.
